thesis: Pre-open headlines for 2026-06-09 show easing geopolitical headwinds ('Oil prices fall on Iran deal; S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rise') alongside commentary on big tech AI strategies (Google vs Nvidia comparisons) and private IPO speculation (SpaceX, Anthropic/OpenAI). None of these headlines present a clear fundamental catalyst or sector rotation rationale requiring portfolio adjustments. Our current balanced allocation across broad equity (VTI), fixed-income ballast (BND), and technology/semiconductor growth (NVDA, XLK) is well-diversified and directly exposed to broad market upside. Holding all 4 positions (cap 6), keeping all weights well below the 35% single-name cap, and retaining our $35.00 cash reserve (~33% of equity vs the 15% floor) maintains portfolio discipline without incurring unprompted transaction churn.
